title: Trono qhipäxan Iyawsäwipa
intro: Yaqhip almanakax janiw ninampi jan ukax uma jalsumpi yant’atäpkiti, jan ukasti mä tirano palacio manqhan jakañax k’achat k’achat yant’atawa. Uka jaqejj mä apnaqirin jakʼapan saytʼatäskäna, jupajj markapar diosätwa sasaw säna, ukampis jamasat mä sapa Cheqpach Diosar iyawsañaruw katjjasïna. Kunawsatix jupanakan yupaychäwipax jikxataskän ukhax t’aqhisiñanakax purintäna — ukampis mä divin arsutax ukhamarakiw purintäna. ¿Khitis akax uk amuytʼasmati?
clues: Uraqijan wali chʼamani apnaqeripan uta manqhanwa jakasiyäta, uka cargojj jukʼanikiw amuyaspäna.
Chachajax jaqinak nayraqatan sayt’asisinx diosjamaw sasaw yatiyasïna — ukampis chuymajax Mä Chiqpach Tatitunkiwa.
jamasat mayisiñanak jiskhtʼasirïta, chachaja jan ukajj warmijar jan istʼapki ukanakarojj mutuyatäpjjañap ajjsarasa.
Kunawsatix iyawsäwijax qhanstawaykän ukhax katuntataw uñjasiwayta ukat t’aqhisiyataw uñjasiwayta — ukampis lakajax janipuniw mä arus jan iyawsäwimp arskänti.
Nayajj Tatitujaruw chuymaj yatiyta, Paraison mä uta mayisiyäta, taqe jan wali lurañanakat jayarstʼata.
Nayax Asiya bint Muzahim — Faraonan warmipätwa, jupax Musa ukat Harun ukanakaruw uñisïna.

identity.label: ¿Khitis nayajja?
options: Asiya bint Muzahim (Faraonan warmipa)
Hawawa (Eva), nayrïr warmi
Sara, Ibrahim chachan nayrïr warmipa
Agar, Isma'il chachan taykapa
Maryam (Imran chachan warmipa) taykapa .

trial.label: Yant’awi/Evento
options: Iyawsäwip jan jaytañ munatapat tʼaqhisiyañ aguantaña
Jach’a challwa puraka manqhan jakaña
Uma jalsut qhispiñatakix mä jachʼa arca luraña
Mä nina nakhaskir ninar jaquntatäña
Mä jach’a qutan t’aqanuqtatap uñjasa
trial.answer: Iyawsäwip jan jaytañ munatapat tʼaqhisiyañ aguantaña

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa
options: Paraison jupanakatak lurat mä uta
Mä thujru, ukax mä katariruw tukuwayi
Mä arca, sapa luratanakan parinakapar aptʼata
Mä markan yupaychata quri vaca qallu
Mä jach’a nuwasir jaqir atipt’añatak apnaqat mä chhullunkha

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Suma jaqenakamp chika Paraison jakasiñampiw jachʼañchatäna
Ejercitopampiw oladanak manqhan umamp chhaqhata
Nina nakhantat ukampis Diosan yanaptʼapampiw qhespiyasïna
Mä jach’a uywamp manq’antat ukat qutar jaquntatäna
Uka tiempon jukʼamp qamir jaqeruw tukjjäna
outcome.answer: Suma jaqenakamp chika Paraison jakasiñampiw jachʼañchatäna

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
